title: Houston finds hidden stones and senses their energy

tellings.quote: his room a little bit later and he had lined these three stones up on his bedside table

plain: A mother named Katie says that her son Houston, one of the children in the Telepathy Tapes, found three stones that had been hidden and could sense their energy. The Telepathy Tapes is a documentary about children who cannot speak and are said to read minds. She says that a little later she found he had lined the three stones up on his bedside table in his room in Atlanta, Georgia. Katie tells it as someone who was there, as a sign the boy can perceive things he was never shown.
